key_insight: Knee3DVLM combines full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE knee MRI to better predict detailed MRI findings than either sequence alone.
clinical_relevance: This could support more comprehensive structured reporting of knee MRI by helping capture complementary information from standard clinical sequences.
method: Sequence-aware vision-language model for 3D knee MRI
Inputs: full-volume DESS, TSE, or both together
Predicts 57 anatomically resolved binary MOAKS-derived targets
evidence_signal: On 1,074 held-out examinations, the fused DESS-TSE model had the best performance, with 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC.
watch_item: Performance was tested on retrospective subject-disjoint partitions, so real-world generalizability and workflow integration still need further validation.
paper_title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
